decisions.reason: Its dedicated page in 2024 shows public commitment, and as a close extension of the firm's enterprise-geospatial integration offer management is likely to justify the earlier launch and give it more time.

As a multi-model framework close to the core software business, it likely embodies meaningful development investment that a medium German GeoIT firm would be reluctant to write off despite only moderate website prominence.

The explicit public launch messaging and separate 2024 page indicate visible commitment, and the service fits the firm's strategic direction toward integrated GeoIT and user management, which supports continuation.

Although a workshop format is relatively easy to discontinue because it ties up fewer sunk costs than software products, its own page and strong fit with the established consulting business still make continuation more likely than withdrawal.
